div.style: color: rgb(23, 37, 84) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;

Validate config and storage
Start with live submission disabled

div.style: color: rgb(20, 62, 56) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;

Reconcile durable state
Paginated orders and fills, account positions
Resolve existing intents and reservations

span.p:
DEGRADED
Read visibility where available
Cancel / reconcile remain available
New exposure blocked

div.style: color: rgb(23, 37, 84) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;

Start and verify data feeds
Fresh snapshots; valid stream sequence
Required tasks healthy

div.style: color: rgb(23, 37, 84) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;

span.p:
READY
Dashboard and analysis available
Live trading remains disarmed

div.style: color: rgb(20, 62, 56) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ACTIVE
All new exposure passes execution policy

div.style: color: rgb(88, 63, 13) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PAUSED
Latch submission gate
Track in-flight requests and existing orders

div.style: color: rgb(88, 63, 13) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center; width: 350px;

STOPPING
Block new submissions
Cancel owned orders and reconcile in-flight requests

div.style: color: rgb(88, 63, 13) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;

span.p: All order outcomes confirmed within deadline?

Persist unresolved state and exit with warning

Next startup must reconcile
